contents.name: Aeries Parent and Student Portal
contents.description: Secure Aeries portal where parents view and update emergency contacts and student medical information, see test scores, elementary report cards and real-time attendance, and complete the annual release acknowledgements and permissions (required annually; replaces paper emergency cards). Self-registering: families receive an email in August; account setup needs an email address, the student ID number, the primary phone number on file and a verification code. Source: https://www.vacavilleusd.org/parents___families/parent_portal

contents.name: After-School Program (ASES / ELO-P) Registration
contents.description: After School Education & Safety (ASES) and Expanded Learning Opportunities Program (ELO-P) for TK-6th grade: homework help, hands-on enrichment and social activities after school. Register online (6crickets). Families seeking priority placement submit the UPP Form; low-income status must be re-confirmed each school year. Contact: Afterschool@vacavilleusd.org. Source: https://www.vacavilleusd.org/parents___families/expanded_learning_opportunities_program

contents.eligibility_description: All VUSD students are eligible. State requirements prioritize students in grades TK-6 who are experiencing homelessness, foster youth, English learners, or low-income (eligible for free or reduced-price meals).

contents.name: Apply for a Job at VUSD
contents.description: Current certificated, classified and management job openings at Vacaville Unified, with online applications on the district's job portal (jobs.vacavilleusd.org). Openings are also posted on EdJoin (https://www.edjoin.org/vacavilleusd). Human Resources, 401 Nut Tree Road, Vacaville, CA 95687, (707) 453-6114. Source: https://www.vacavilleusd.org/departments/human_resources/employment_opportunities

contents.name: Apply for Free and Reduced-Price Meals (California Universal Benefits Application)
contents.description: Online California Universal Benefits Application (UBA) via LINQ Connect, linked from VUSD Student Nutrition ("Sun Bucks - UBA"). The application may qualify a child for benefits such as Summer EBT/SUN Bucks, internet access and school transportation, and confirms low-income status (needed each school year for priority in programs such as ASES/ELO-P). Completing it does not affect a student's ability to receive school meals at no cost; the district notifies families of eligibility within 15 days. Source: https://www.vacavilleusd.org/departments/student_nutrition

contents.name: Apply to Become a Substitute
contents.description: Apply for certificated (substitute teacher) and classified substitute positions with Vacaville Unified via the district job portal. Substitute Services handles onboarding of all substitutes; credential questions go to credentials@vacavilleusd.org, and a CTC credential can be applied for online with the California Commission on Teacher Credentialing. Source: https://www.vacavilleusd.org/departments/human_resources/substitute_hiring

contents.name: Caregiver's Authorization Affidavit
contents.description: California Caregiver's Authorization Affidavit, an alternative to legal guardianship that lets an adult caring for a minor enroll the student and make school-related decisions. Only the caregiver signs; the form must be notarized and renewed each school year, and approval is granted by the Student Attendance and Welfare Department. Available in English and Spanish. Source: https://www.vacavilleusd.org/departments/student_attendance___welfare/enrollment/caregiver_s_affidavit

contents.name: Care Solace Mental Health Care Navigation
contents.description: Through a VUSD partnership, Care Solace connects students, staff and families to mental health and substance use providers matched to their needs, at no cost and confidentially. A multilingual team is available 24/7/365 to explain options, call providers and schedule appointments; any coverage accepted including Medi-Cal, Medicare and sliding scale. Call (888) 515-0595 or book online. Source: https://www.vacavilleusd.org/departments/mental_health_supports

contents.name: File a Citizen Complaint
contents.description: File a formal complaint concerning VUSD employees using the Citizen Complaint Form (English; Spanish also available), under BP/AR 1312.1. The district encourages early, informal resolution first. District Compliance Officer: Director of Human Resources, 401 Nut Tree Road, Vacaville, CA 95687, (707) 454-3514, fax (707) 453-6999; email complaints@vacavilleusd.org. Complaints about pupil fees are filed with the school principal. Source: https://www.vacavilleusd.org/departments/human_resources/vusd_complaints/district_complaints

contents.name: Foster and Homeless Youth (McKinney-Vento) Support
contents.description: The VUSD Foster & Homeless Youth Liaison helps foster youth and students without permanent housing with immediate enrollment (even without records), remaining in the school of origin, school placement and educational issues. Additional supports may include school supplies, clothing and hygiene items, transportation, free breakfast and lunch, fee waivers, records transfers and adjusted graduation credit requirements. Contact the liaison at (707) 453-6137 or the school counselor. Source: https://www.vacavilleusd.org/departments/foster_and_homeless

contents.name: InterDistrict Attendance Permit (Transfer Out of VUSD)
contents.description: VUSD residents requesting to attend school in another district complete the 2026-2027 InterDistrict Attendance Permit and submit it to Student Attendance and Welfare at the Educational Services Center, 401 Nut Tree Road, Vacaville, CA 95687, in person, by fax (707) 453-7115, or by email to transfers@vacavilleusd.org; it is then forwarded to the requested district. Students living outside VUSD who want to attend VUSD must obtain an approved permit from their district of residence, which sends it to VUSD; approval is based on space, grades, discipline and attendance, and denials may be appealed in writing within 10 school days. Spanish form also available. Source: https://www.vacavilleusd.org/departments/student_attendance___welfare/enrollment/school_transfers

contents.name: IntraDistrict Transfer Request (Within VUSD)
contents.description: Parents and guardians residing within VUSD boundaries may apply for their child to attend a different VUSD school by submitting an IntraDistrict Attendance Agreement. Placement follows resident placement and space availability, with priority for administrative placements, siblings, and continuing students who moved within the district. Separate policies apply to incoming K-6 and 7-12 students. Open Enrollment is no longer offered. Source: https://www.vacavilleusd.org/departments/student_attendance___welfare/enrollment/school_transfers

contents.description: For school personnel to give prescription or non-prescription medication during school hours, the parent/guardian and the student's doctor complete the "Authorization For Medication Required During School Hours" form, which a parent or designated adult brings to the school office with the medication in its original labeled container. Renew each school year or when the medication changes. Students may self-carry only asthma and/or epinephrine auto-injector medication with physician authorization. Students who previously attended a VUSD school should contact their new school instead. Questions: enrollment@vacavilleusd.org. contents.name: School Developer Fee Payment
contents.description: Statutory (level 1) school developer fees for new construction in VUSD. Current rates: residential $5.17 per sq ft (additions and ADUs of 500 sq ft or more, and all new construction); commercial/industrial $0.84 per sq ft; additions and ADUs under 500 sq ft exempt. Rates rise on October 19, 2026 to $5.38 (residential) and $0.87 (commercial/industrial) per sq ft. Complete the "Applicant" and "City of Vacaville" sections of the VUSD Developer Fee Form and bring it to the Fiscal Services office, Educational Services Center, 401 Nut Tree Rd, Vacaville CA 95687. 2026 Addendum to Fee Justification Study is posted on the page. contents.name: Special Education Evaluation Request (Child Find)
contents.description: VUSD conducts multi-disciplinary evaluations and consultations for children suspected of having a disability. To request an assessment, contact your child's school principal; if your child is not yet school age, call the Special Education Department at (707) 453-7212 (spedinfo@vacavilleusd.org). Assessment is done only with parent permission; an IEP meeting is held within 60 days of receiving a signed assessment plan. Early Start services are available from birth to three for vision, hearing or orthopedic disabilities. All services are confidential and provided at no cost to the family. Source: https://www.vacavilleusd.org/departments/special_education/getting_help_for_your_child

contents.name: State Preschool Enrollment (Shelley Dally Early Learning Village)
contents.description: Apply for VUSD State Preschool through the online enrollment platform (create an account and verify email). Required documents include parent photo ID, family-size documentation, proof of Vacaville residence, proof of income if income-qualifying, immunization records and a recent physician's report. Priority: referred neglected, abused or homeless children; then CSPP-eligible children with exceptional needs; then CSPP-eligible children by income ranking; waiting lists kept. Preschool office: 707-453-6148, Shelley Dally Early Learning Village, 621 South Orchard, Vacaville. Source: https://preschool.vacavilleusd.org/enrollment
